mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL reading indicates elevated inflation, which typically prompts central banks to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, thereby generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth prospects and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% and sustained for 3 months), higher interest rates reduce the present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor during tightening cycles is > -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 130,000, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate production capacity and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a dual stress in the housing market and labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp from prior month
failure_condition: When HOUST declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp from prior month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a consumer spending boom (RSAFS growth rate exceeding 0.5% monthly), strong retail sales support corporate revenue growth and positive earnings revisions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods when RSAFS increases > 0.5% from prior month, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
